avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce galantamine bioavailability and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before initiating St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Anticholinergic Supplements (Jimsonweed, Datura)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism of galantamine's cholinergic effects; increased risk of toxicity with opposing mechanisms
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; educate patient to avoid completely

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase galantamine levels; additive cholinergic effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for enhanced cholinergic symptoms (nausea, bradycardia); dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Cholinergic Supplements (Choline, Lecithin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive cholinergic stimulation may enhance side effects without clear therapeutic benefit
caution_supplements.action: Use together cautiously; monitor for excessive salivation, sweating, or GI distress

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (taken with galantamine)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly increases galantamine absorption and peak levels, increasing side effect risk
avoid_foods.action: Administer galantamine consistently with or without food; avoid taking after high-fat meals

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase galantamine concentration
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for enhanced cholinergic adverse effects (nausea, diarrhea, bradycardia)

monitoring_notes: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure regularly, as galantamine can cause bradycardia and syncope. Watch for cholinergic toxicity signs including nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle weakness, and potential GI bleeding in susceptible patients.
